name: Natsuiro Kokoa
source: The only daughter of the ultra-wealthy Natsuiro family. An energetic and optimistic girl who always has a smile on her face, she also loves magical girl anime. Because her servants have done everything for her, she feels dissatisfied with her life. Her parents made her become one of the wife candidates in order increase their assets. However, Kokoa doesn't care about this at all and just enjoys high school and campus life very much.
